title: Create or Amend Provisional Figures Information
description: This endpoint is used to create or amend provisional figures information to confirm whether provisional figures are included in a tax return and, where applicable, to provide the reason for using them and the expected date when final figures will be available. A National Insurance number and tax year are required. This endpoint can only be used after the tax year has ended.

provisionalFiguresIndicator.description: Indicates whether provisional figures are included in the tax return. The value must be true.

expectedDate.description:
The expected date when the final figures will be available. This date must be in the future.

Must conform to the format: YYYY-MM-DD

supplementaryInformation.description: Additional information describing the use of provisional figures. Must not be empty or contain only whitespace.
supplementaryInformation.example: Provisional figures used pending final confirmation.
